description: This file declares internal functions, data structures, and external references related to the Zephyr OS settings subsystem, specifically for managing settings lines, including reading, writing, copying, and context management.

methods.name: settings_line_write
methods.description: Writes a settings line with specified name and value to storage.

methods.name: settings_line_len_calc
methods.description: Calculates length of a settings record without alignment.

methods.name: settings_line_dup_check_cb
methods.description: Checks for duplicate settings line entries.

methods.name: settings_line_load_cb
methods.description: Callback for loading a settings line.

methods.name: settings_next_line_ctx
methods.description: Advances to the next line context in storage.

methods.name: settings_line_raw_read
methods.description: Reads raw settings line data from storage.

methods.name: settings_line_val_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a settings line.

methods.name: settings_line_name_read
methods.description: Reads the name of a settings line from storage.

methods.name: settings_line_val_get_len
methods.description: Gets length of a value in a settings line.

methods.name: settings_line_entry_copy
methods.description: Copies a settings line entry from source to destination.

methods.name: settings_line_io_init
methods.description: Initializes I/O callbacks for settings line operations.
